Visible columns
Global score settings

A separate 0–100 preference score across the full movie library. Filters and searches never change these scores. Each field contributes according to its weight; 0 disables it. Click any global score for its breakdown.

Percentiles use movies with known values across the entire library: the percentage below your value, plus half the percentage tied with it. If every known value is equal, that field scores 50. Missing values use your chosen missing-data score.

Field weights

Genre points

Give each genre −10 to +10 points. A movie’s raw genre score is the average across all its genres, including genres left at 0. For example, Thriller 3 and Horror −1 gives a Thriller/Horror movie 1 point.

Numeric preferences

Percentile mode ranks your preferred values against the full library. Fixed mode uses your anchors or target distance. Values beyond the anchors are capped at 0 or 100.

Adult content and missing data

How filter score works

A 0–100 ranking of movies that pass your filters. Active fields use your chosen weights. A weight of 0 removes a field from scoring; with no weighted fields the score is blank. This is a preference score, not a probability or an IMDb score. Click a movie’s score for its breakdown.

    Scoring settings

    Field weights

    Only active filters contribute. Weight 2 counts twice as much as weight 1. Weight 0 ignores that field in scoring.
